title: Cloud Base-Commit Licence Audit
description: An independently reproducible base-commit licence audit: the derivation command, the ordered lineage roster with per-lineage inclusion or exclusion reasons and licence evidence digests, the pinned dataset and task-manifest digests it was derived from, the per-language counts, and a qualification receipt bound to the deriving code and to every input byte. Prose in a decision log or spend ledger is not this record and cannot substitute for it.

derivation.description: Everything a reviewer needs to re-run the derivation and compare byte for byte.

command.description: Argv of the deterministic derivation command, so re-derivation is a paste rather than a reconstruction.

code_sha256.description: Digest of the module that produced this record.

evidence_root.description: Repository-relative root the licence evidence paths resolve against.

pinned_inputs.description: The immutable dataset and task-manifest identities the roster was derived from.

lineages.description: Ordered roster. Order is part of the record: a reviewer re-deriving it must obtain this exact sequence.

language_counts.description: Per-language admissible counts, derived from the roster and cross-checked against it rather than stated independently.

receipt.description: Qualification receipt binding the deriving code and every input byte. Recomputed on validation, never trusted as written.

root_lineage.description: Collapsed root repository identity, not a task id.

base_commit.description: The pinned base commit the licence is judged at. Present-day repository metadata is not this.

reason.description: Explicit inclusion or exclusion reason. Every lineage carries one; silence is not an outcome.

licence.description: SPDX identifier observed at the base commit, or null when none was readable.

licence_evidence.description: Reference and digest of the retrieved licence bytes. Null is permitted only for a lineage excluded because nothing could be retrieved.
